definitions.explanation: A flat piece of wood or other material.
A flat piece of metal or other material.

examples.english: To sit on the wooden floor.
examples.notes: {板|いた}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{間|ま}→間：noentry⟧ = wooden floor

examples.japanese: {板|いた}⟦{挟|ばさ}み→挟む：00091_hasamu⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦なる→なる：01970_naru⟧。
examples.english: To be caught between two sides.

examples.japanese: ⟦{薄|うす}い→薄い：00764_usui⟧⟦{金属|きんぞく}→金属：02645_kinzoku⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{板|いた}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{作|つく}られている→作る：00481_tsukuru⟧。
examples.english: It is made from a thin metal sheet.
Letters were engraved on a copper plate.

notes:
{板|いた} refers to a flat piece of material, primarily wood but also metal or other substances.

COMPOUNDS:
- ⟦{看板|かんばん}→看板：00166_kanban⟧: signboard
- ⟦{黒板|こくばん}→黒板：02756_kokuban⟧: blackboard
- ⟦まな{板|いた}→まな板：04977_manaita⟧: cutting board
- {板|いた}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{間|ま}→間：noentry⟧: wooden-floored room
- {板|いた}⟦チョコ→チョコ：noentry⟧: chocolate bar (bar-shaped)
- ⟦{鉄板|てっぱん}→鉄板：14470_teppan⟧: iron plate (also slang for "guaranteed")

COMMON EXPRESSIONS:
- {板|いた}⟦{挟|ばさ}み→挟む：00091_hasamu⟧: caught between two parties (lit. "sandwiched between boards")
- {板|いた}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{付|つ}く→付く：01960_tsuku⟧: to become well-suited to a role; to look natural doing something

USAGE:
When unqualified, {板|いた} usually implies a wooden board. For other materials, the material is specified: ⟦{鉄|てつ}→鉄：02225_tetsu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{板|いた} (iron plate), ⟦ガラス→ガラス：01777_garasu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{板|いた} (glass plate).
